policy: Claim status is separate from evidence and simulation. Unsupported claims remain visible but cannot write geometry.

claims.counterpoint: Some scholars have proposed Khufu/Djedefre or earlier dates; current integrated sequence/geology evidence favors Khafre.
claims.guard: Attribution is not a camera/survey control.

claims.claim: The Sphinx predates the 4th Dynasty by thousands of years.
claims.guard: Keep alternative claims quarantined unless new independently verifiable evidence enters the corpus.

claims.claim: Giza builders possessed AI/computers or exposure to modern-equivalent computational technology.
claims.guard: Survey precision and algorithmic organization are not evidence of digital computation or AI.

claims.claim: Large deep shafts/terminal structures exist beneath Khafre.
claims.guard: Retain as quarantined claim geometry only; simulations test consequences, not existence.

claims.claim: SAR Doppler tomography publication validates hidden Giza geometry.
claims.guard: Retraction status is part of source truth and cannot be omitted.

claims.claim: Khafre interior was intentionally tuned as an acoustic resonator.
claims.guard: ECHO mode coincidences remain a pattern watch and weaken under construction-aware controls.

claims.claim: Khafre pyramid/deep system functioned as a hydraulic machine or power system.
claims.guard: Static head calculations are conditional physics, not evidence of water, flow, or power.

claims.claim: The Giza pyramid complexes encode a deliberate technical or scientific message intended specifically for people in the distant future.
claims.guard: Durability, precision and symbolic architecture demonstrate communication and permanence, but do not by themselves establish a distant-future technical audience or hidden data payload.
